// diagnostic

E0768

A bare argument follows a labelled one, so it names no parameter (D-APILABEL1)

What

A bare argument follows a labelled one, so it names no parameter (D-APILABEL1)

Why

The registered sema rule applies here

Fix

Follow the guidance for E0768

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E0768: tests/ui/arg_positional_after_label.stderr.

Error [E0768]: this argument to `schedule` follows a labelled one without a label
  --> tests/ui/arg_positional_after_label.jet:3:37
    |
  3 | fn run() { _ :: schedule(repeat: 5, "backup", 30) }
    |                                     ^^^^^^^^
 Why: labels bind by name, so a bare argument after one has no parameter to fill
 Fix: label this argument, or move it before the labelled ones
More: jet-lang.dev/e/E0768
